thread:
julie_support: Hi — customer signed up an hour ago, completed email verification but never got free-trial credits. Account id: acct_01F8D3Z9. They also added a card and saw a "pending verification" state. Can someone take a look?

maria_g: Thanks — forwarding to billing. Do you have the signup flow trace or the payment attempt id?

julie_support: Payment attempt id pay_3q2n, signup via email (not SSO). Saw UI message: "free credits pending verification". Customer is in EU (FR).

billing_bot: Automated check: fraud_score=18, region=FR, card_bin_country=US, 3ds_status=pending, pci_hold=false. No prior history.

alex_k: card_bin_country=US but customer IP/addr indicates FR — BIN mismatch triggered manual review filter. 3DS challenge still pending from PSP. That's the gating rule that blocks auto-credit.

maria_g: Steps to reproduce for ops: 1) create test account with FR locale, 2) add a US-issued card (bin mismatch), 3) complete email verification, 4) observe free-credit state. Can ops confirm logs?

ops_sam: Running the trace now — pulling signup trace and payment webhook. Command I used:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  "https://admin.internal.redwood/api/v1/accounts/acct_01F8D3Z9/signup_trace"
```
Got webhook_id=wh_9c4, webhook_status=processing -> later changed to processed. PSP returned 3DS_REQUIRED at 2024-10-01T09:12:34Z.

julie_support: Customer says they completed a mobile 3DS pop-up and saw a confirmation. UI still says pending.

alex_k: Sometimes PSP posts the final 3DS callback but our listener drops it on a 409 retry if idempotency header missing. I see one failed retry in the logs.

ops_sam: Found the failed delivery: POST /webhooks/psp/3ds cb_987 failed 409 then no retry queued because our webhook worker thought it was duplicate. I've requeued the webhook processing job.

billing_bot: Re-evaluating credit grant rules for acct_01F8D3Z9 after webhook reprocess... result: eligible=true.

maria_g: Before we apply: any reason not to manual-grant? fraud_score low and email verified. Alex?

alex_k: ok to proceed. I'll apply manual override and note the reason: "3DS callback delivery failure caused gating; manual grant after PSP confirmation."

alex_k: (performed) granted 1000 free-credit units to acct_01F8D3Z9. Audit id: audit_20241001_5543. Notified customer via support.

julie_support: Customer confirmed they now see credits and can call the API. Thanks team. I'll close the ticket after 24h confirmation.

maria_g: Action item: add a small retry/backoff for webhook 409s from PSP and improve logging for idempotency mismatch. Filing a follow-up in eng-infra.

ops_sam: +1. Also adding a temporary dashboard alert for webhook failure spikes so we detect this earlier.

julie_support: Noted. Closing when customer confirms. :white_check_mark:
